title: PipeShare video starts on a light preview
description:
Inspection videos were one big file, so playback waited on that file even after range requests worked. PipeShare now builds a short preview next to the original and plays the preview first, then steps up to the full picture as the buffer fills.

New uploads are prepared on the server with ffmpeg. An older video is prepared the first time someone presses play. Until that preview exists, the player keeps using the current Wasabi range link, so nothing goes blank. Video bytes still come from Wasabi. The original inspection file is kept. The same code runs on pipeshare.live and pipeshare.net.

Who is affected: PipeShare in the browser on the private server and SaaS. Desktop Auto Sync uploads are unchanged. The first play of a large video can sit on the original file for a few minutes while the preview is built. Very large files (over about 4 GB) stay on range playback.
changeLog: PipeShare stores a two-step HLS preview beside each video and keeps the original file.
The player starts on the light preview and steps up to the full file as the buffer allows.
If the preview is not ready, playback uses the existing presigned MP4 range link.
New uploads are queued for a preview. Older videos are queued the first time they are played.
Preview bytes are presigned from Wasabi. The portal only sends the small playlist.
